camera_position: on the Kamenne namestie plaza south-west of the 1968 department store (OSM 'OD Bratislava' 48.14534,17.11435; Hotel Kyjev 48.14607,17.11500)
evidence: painting: the white department store and the Hotel Kyjev tower fill the view ahead, i.e. the camera faces NE/NNE from the plaza (bearings from the plaza: store 35-65 deg, Kyjev 20-35 deg)
the painting is a composite (Kyjev drawn right of the store; from the real plaza it stands left of it), hence medium confidence; every exit decision below holds for any heading between 0 and 60 deg
